terms.comment: Where something is or happens online. Traupman has no phrase for it, but his interrēte takes in as any place does; Traupman’s own download, ex rēte prehendere (p. 260), uses the ablative rēte. With a verb of motion, in interrēte with the accusative (see post).

terms.gloss: online, on the internet (of a thing)
terms.comment: Traupman’s adjective, as in situs interrētiālis (see website).

sources: Lewis & Short: rete
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 260–261, 334.
